heading: Pick a place
tapHint: Tap the map to pick a point.
radiusHint: A point is kept when it lies within this distance.
errorEmpty: Type both a latitude and a longitude.
errorNumber: Use numbers in decimal degrees, for example 42.7 and 23.3.
errorLat: Latitude has to be between -90 and 90.
errorLon: Longitude has to be between -180 and 180.
drawHint: Click the corners on the map, then click the first corner again to close the area.
countryNoMatch: No country in the data set matches that.
countryFallbackNote: Only the countries in the current data set can be chosen.
